profile.headline: Principal Engineer at Cummins Inc. | Founder, iVERA — AI receptionist for salons & barbershops | Python · AWS · React | Building the tool that answers every call 24/7
profile.summary:
I build things at two scales.
 
By day, I'm a Principal Engineer at Cummins Inc., where I architect cloud infrastructure powering one of the world's largest engine manufacturers. Five years of building production systems across AWS — Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, EC2, CloudFormation — at enterprise scale. I've designed CI/CD pipelines, serverless architectures, and real-time data systems that serve global operations.
 
By night (and most weekends), I'm building iVERA — an AI receptionist for hair salons, barbershops, and spas. The average salon loses $14,300/year to missed calls during appointments. iVERA answers every call, books every appointment, and sends every reminder. 24/7. Trained on each salon's specific services, hours, and personality.
 
The tech behind iVERA: React + TypeScript frontend, FastAPI (Python) backend, Supabase (PostgreSQL), Retell AI for voice, ElevenLabs for voice synthesis, Telnyx for SMS/phone, deployed on AWS Lambda. Everything I learned building enterprise infrastructure at Cummins, applied to a product that helps small business owners sleep at night.
 
What I care about: → Building systems that scale without breaking at 3am → Using AI for something that genuinely helps real people → The intersection of enterprise engineering and startup speed
 
Currently: founding partner program open for salon owners nationwide. If you own a salon, barbershop, or spa — or know someone who does — I'd love to hear from you.
 
ivera.ai

positions.title: Founder & CEO
positions.description:
Building an AI receptionist for hair salons, barbershops, and spas — the first platform that answers phone calls, books appointments, and sends reminders autonomously, 24/7.
The problem: the average salon misses 4–8 calls per week during appointments. At $55 per service, that's $14,300–$22,880/year leaving as voicemail. No existing booking software (Vagaro, Square, GlossGenius) solves this because none of them answer the phone.
What I built:
→ AI voice receptionist powered by Retell AI + ElevenLabs (3 customizable voice personas)
→ Real-time appointment booking with multi-staff calendar management
→ SMS/email confirmations and 24-hour + 1-hour reminders
→ Business intelligence dashboard with verified metrics
→ 10-minute onboarding — zero technical knowledge required
Tech stack: React 18 + TypeScript, FastAPI (Python 3.12), Supabase (PostgreSQL), Retell AI, ElevenLabs, Telnyx, Stripe, AWS Lambda (Serverless Framework).
Pricing: $149/month flat + 2.5% performance fee on AI-generated bookings only. We earn more only when the salon earns more.
Currently serving founding partner salons nationwide. 14-day free trial at ivera.ai.
positions.insights: Skills: Product Development · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Software as a Service (SaaS) · Voice AI · Cloud-Native Architecture · TypeScript · FastAPI · Serverless Computing · Startup Founder

positions.title: Prinicipal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Principal Engineer architecting cloud infrastructure and serverless solutions for one of the world's largest powertrain manufacturers (Fortune 150, $28B+ revenue, 73,000+ employees globally).
Current scope:
→ Designing and maintaining production AWS architectures: Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, EC2, S3, CloudFormation, CodePipeline, CodeBuild, CodeDeploy
→ Building CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code across multiple engineering teams
→ Leading migration of legacy systems to serverless and microservices architectures
→ Implementing security and compliance frameworks: IAM, KMS, WAF, VPC, Trusted Advisor
→ Real-time data processing with Kinesis, SQS, SNS for IoT and manufacturing systems
→ Cost optimization and architecture reviews across AWS accounts (Cost Explorer, Trusted Advisor)
Technologies: Python, Django, Java, React, PostgreSQL, Redis, DynamoDB, MySQL — full-stack across cloud and application layers.
Previously held progressive engineering roles at Cummins over 5 years before promotion to Principal Engineer.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Design and implement AWS-based architectures for the company's products, including SaaS and PaaS solutions, leveraging services such as EC2, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, Lambda, API Gateway, and CloudFront.
• Develop and maintain automation tools and processes using CloudFormation, AWS CLI, AWS SDK, and AWS Lambda functions to ensure consistent and repeatable infrastructure deployment, configuration, and management.
• Implement containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes, leveraging tools such as EKS, and Fargate, to improve the scalability, resilience, and portability of applications.
• Create and maintain CI/CD pipelines using AWS CodeCommit, AWS CodeBuild, and AWS CodeDeploy, to automate application deployment, testing, and release management.
• Define and enforce network architecture and security policies using AWS VPC, security groups, NACLs, VPN, AWS Shield, and AWS WAF, to ensure compliance with industry regulations and company policies.
• Optimize cloud costs by monitoring and analyzing cloud usage patterns, rightsizing instances, leveraging AWS Reserved Instances and Savings Plans, and implementing cost allocation tags and budgets.
• Lead cross-functional teams and collaborate with stakeholders to identify business requirements, develop technical solutions, and provide guidance and support throughout the project lifecycle.
• Design and implement AWS-based architectures for the company's flagship products, resulting in a 35% reduction in infrastructure costs and improved system performance.
• Collaborated with the DevOps team to implement a CI/CD pipeline for a web application, resulting in a 50% reduction in deployment time and a 20% increase in team productivity.
• Developed automation tools and processes using CloudFormation, and Bash scripts to streamline infrastructure deployment and management, resulting in a 40% reduction in deployment times and a 60% reduction in manual errors.

positions.title: AWS Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented a highly available and scalable cloud infrastructure on AWS for a SaaS startup, resulting in a 30% increase in system performance and a 25% reduction in infrastructure costs.
• Design and deploy AWS infrastructure for multiple projects, including EC2 instances, S3 buckets, RDS instances, and VPCs, ensuring high availability, scalability, and security.
• Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, and deployment using AWS CloudFormation and AWS CLI, reducing manual errors, and improving efficiency.
• Configure and maintain AWS services such as AWS Elastic Load Balancer (ELB), AWS Route 53, AWS CloudFront, and AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM), ensuring secure and reliable operation.
• Implement AWS security best practices, including network segmentation, identity and access management, encryption, and auditing, ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations.
• Monitor AWS infrastructure using AWS CloudWatch, AWS Config, and AWS Trusted Advisor, identifying and resolving issues proactively, resulting in improved uptime and availability.
• Collaborate with development teams to optimize application architecture for AWS deployment, utilizing services such as AWS Lambda, AWS API Gateway, and AWS Elastic Beanstalk, resulting in improved scalability and performance.
• Implemented and maintained AWS security best practices, including IAM, security groups, NACLs, and encryption, ensuring data confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
• Migrated on-premises infrastructure to AWS, including virtual machines, applications, and databases, using AWS Database Migration Service (DMS), and AWS Schema Conversion Tool (SCT), resulting in improved agility, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
• Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines using AWS CodePipeline, AWS CodeBuild, and AWS CodeDeploy, enabling rapid and frequent deployments, and reducing downtime.

positions.title: Network Administrator
positions.description:
• Installing and maintaining network hardware and software.
• Designed, implemented, and maintained the company's local and wide area networks, including routers, switches, firewalls, and wireless access points, resulting in a secure and reliable network infrastructure.
• Monitored network performance, identified, and resolved network issues, and performed network optimization, resulting in increased uptime and improved network efficiency.
• Configured and maintained network security systems, including firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and VPNs, ensuring data confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
• Configured and maintained network services such as DNS, DHCP, and LDAP, enabling efficient network management and user authentication.
• Managed network devices and software through a centralized management system, ensuring consistent configurations and efficient updates.
• Configured and maintained network authentication and authorization systems, including Active Directory and LDAP, ensuring secure user access and authentication.

positions.title: Intern - network administrator
positions.description:
• Assisted in configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting LAN, WAN, and WLAN environments, gaining knowledge in network operations and troubleshooting.
• Assisted in implementing network security policies, including firewalls, VPNs, and intrusion prevention systems, gaining knowledge in network security practices.
• Installed and maintained network hardware and software, including routers, switches, firewalls, and wireless access points, learning about network infrastructure and equipment.
• Gained knowledge in DNS, DHCP, and IP address management, assisting with IP address allocation and management tasks.
• Assisted in configuring and maintaining network authentication and authorization systems, including Active Directory and LDAP, gaining experience in user access and authentication.
• Contributed to the development and maintenance of network documentation, including network topology diagrams, hardware and software inventory, and network configuration files, ensuring accurate and up-to-date information.

projects.title: Online Car Selling System
projects.description: The system is providing a way where any user or customer can easily make their deal with direct dealer which provides service regarding “Car Services”. It’s also providing an information for solving the customers query regarding buying and selling a new or old Car. The system could be providing an environment to for customer where customer, where Dealers can easily post all the details regarding their Car for the selling purpose and Customers can view those Cars, Search Cars (under kind of their needs and requirements) and if interested can contact the respective Dealers. The system also provides facility to compare cars and provides information regarding Automobile Industry (i.e. can view information about the upcoming Cars and other relevant information.).
